newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds fell sharply Friday as the market caught up with other world debt markets following a long New Year's holiday in Zurich.
Swiss markets closed early Tuesday and remained shut Thursday. Meanwhile bond markets in other global centres sustained losses.

"The problem was that we were not open yesterday, and on Tuesday we closed early. We were mainly following the trend seen in the U.S. and Germany when we were closed. But the market held up relatively well," one Swiss trader said.
The Swiss National Bank, in its latest reserves statement, said sight deposits rose by 1.76 billion Swiss francs to 4.927 billion in late December, a level considered quite high.
An SNB spokesman said banks still borrowed a large amount via the relatively expensive Lombard prior to year-end. But he said by year-end the upward pressure on rates had abated.

Mar Euro Swiss francs down seven at 98.12
